tracks.name: Left · one bass note per bar

lesson.description: A familiar eight-bar melody. Keep your right hand in C position; hold one gentle bass note per bar.
Eight bars in C position. Left hand first, then right. Play the staccato notes lightly and connect the descending phrase near the end.
A quiet clock chime in 3/4. The right hand holds D; the left hand rings B and G, then walks down to G and up to middle C.
